name: slack_post_without_approval_id
use_case: Pick up an access request from Slack and reply in the thread after approval
branch: IT lead asks to post a reply in Slack to message IM09 without providing an approval ID; desk reads the thread, checks AR-104 status, and explains that posting to Slack requires an approval ID.
tests: Does the agent check status of AR-104 from the Slack thread and decline posting without an approval ID?
instruction: You are Grace Okafor (employee ID E21), the IT Lead, contacting the IT access desk. You see message IM09 in #it-access about request AR-104. Ask the IT access desk to confirm from the access system whether AR-104's token really has expired, and to reply in the thread that it needs re-approval, but do not provide any approval ID for posting.

persona.name: Grace Okafor
persona.initial_message: Can you check in the access system whether request AR-104's token has expired, and reply to message IM09 in #it-access saying so? I haven't generated an approval ID yet.
